collection.title: Peugeot 306 Saloon 1997 to 2002 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot 306 Saloon model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 00" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit style blade too.
